audit.whatIsWrong: The whole full layer is built around Steadfast Presence as the matchup-defining ability ('Stops every dash near her — mobility dies inside the zone', focus, cooldowns, trade rules). Against Lillia it does almost nothing.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence stops enemy DASHES. Lillia has no dash — Blooming Blows is a short activated AoE with stacking Move Speed, and movement speed is not a dash, so the grounding and dash-stop never trigger on her. Against Lillia the W is a passive resist buff plus a move-speed button for Poppy. The real matchup-definer is Heroic Charge (475 range, 14/13/12/11/10s), which stuns only when it pins her into terrain.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block re-pointed at Heroic Charge with its range and cooldown, and it now says explicitly that Steadfast Presence stops dashes she does not have.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four strings call Hammer Shock a knockup ('Poppy's Q knockup', 'Q-knockup-into-W follow-up', 'then Q-knockup and W').
audit.why: Hammer Shock deals damage and creates a slowing zone that explodes after a delay — no displacement. The knockup in her kit is Keeper's Verdict (R); Heroic Charge is a push that stuns on terrain. Being told to fear a Q knockup makes a player mis-read every level-1 trade.
audit.corrected: All four rewritten to Hammer Shock's slow zone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five chart rows contradicted the whys — Level 1 marked Lillia when the text concedes it, Levels 3 and 6 marked Poppy/Lillia when the text calls them even, Levels 4-5 and First item marked Poppy when the text calls them Lillia's windows.
audit.why: Poppy's spike is level 1 raw stats and every point of resist she buys; Lillia's are full-rank Blooming Blows at 4-5 and the first burn item. Level 6 is genuinely split — her sleep is real but does not solo a tank.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Poppy / Skill / Skill / Lillia / Skill / Lillia / Poppy with ratings 3, 4, 5, 6, 5, 6, 4, as matched full+content pairs.

audit.why: EVEN at 5.5/10 matches 48.68%. The lane is decided by whether Lillia keeps herself off walls.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero sequencing cues, and no Poppy ability was ever named on the page.
audit.why: Heroic Charge's 14s rank-1 cooldown and its terrain requirement are the two facts that tell a Lillia when she may step up and where she may stand.
audit.corrected: Both written into the Don'ts and the cooldown block.

edits.before: Poppy out-stats you at level 1 — her Q knockup and tank base beat your single ability, so just last-hit with the tip of your Q censer and don't get greedy. The whole lane is her E: it pins you to a wall and stuns, and that single lock-down hands her the Q-knockup-into-W follow-up that erases your kite. Hug the open side of the lane, never hop toward a wall when her E is up, and let her come to you so your Dream Dust burn starts ticking on a champ who can't catch you.

notes: Two real errors here. (1) Hammer Shock is not a knockup — it is a delayed slow zone; the knockup is Keeper's Verdict. (2) More importantly, the entire full layer treats Steadfast Presence as the matchup-defining ability, but it stops DASHES and Lillia has none; her mobility is Blooming Blows' Move Speed, which W does not touch. The ability that actually decides this lane is Heroic Charge, and only when a wall is behind Lillia. focus.text ('Poppy Steadfast Presence') is 24 characters and so falls under the applier's 25-character skip, which is why I did not propose it — it still points at the wrong ability and needs a manual fix or a shorter/longer replacement.
